Commentary.Commentary: The players are back out in the middle. No Jos Buttler today, so Jason Roy is opening with Dawid Malan. Seems like Jonny Bairstow will bat at three. Imad Wasim will start the proceedings. Roy to face. Here we go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

The bowling from England was taken to the cleaners. Cannot say it was totally bad bowling as Morgan was deliberately putting his bowlers to the sword and taking chances with his bowling combinations. But that affected England as their bowlers were never able to stick to consistent lines. No one could put any kind of pressure with Tom Curran finishing with the most number of wickets. Seems like a bridge too far for England to cross. But, can they? Stay tuned.

Stuart Broad's home ground is one which has very small square boundaries. So no surprises why Eoin Morgan chose to field. That meant Pakistan needed a minimum score of 200, to be competitive and competitive they surely were. They entered with a new opening combination of Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan and the duo batted well for 10 overs, getting 80 but then changed their gears altogether. 152 runs came in the next 10 overs, as after Babar and Rizwan's 150-run opening stand, everyone who came in played brilliant cameos.

Phew. We have a break. Yay! What was that? Slap. Bang. Wham. Slaughter. With Eoin Morgan donning the role of a scientist prepared to experiment with his team, Pakistan left no guns barred to showcase their intention. They are not here to be guinea pigs of England's experimentation. What a batting show.

OUT! A run out to end the innings. PAKISTAN END ON A COMMANDING 232/6. Around middle, Imad swings it towards long on. They were always going for the second, even if that meant taking the second on the throw. Jason Roy exhibits good fielding skills as he throws it perfectly to his opening partner. Jonny Bairstow collects the ball and disturbs the stumps with Imad diving after the bails get dislodged. Miles short.
Interesting. Mo is moved even finer now.

In the air... Moeen Ali ... DROPS IT! A full ball, around middle, Imad Wasim gets across on a knee and scoops this miles in the air. Does not have enough on it and Moeen has some sprinting to do from fine leg to his left. Gets to the ball, it touches his left palm, but goes down. A couple of runs taken.
A short ball, around middle, Khan pulls this towards deep square leg for a run.

Excellent delivery. Speared on the toes, around middle and leg, Azam misses his flick cum sweep and is hit on the pads. The ball deflects to the off side and the batsmen take a single. The fielder from point comes running in, has a shy at the bowler's end, but not only does he miss the stumps, he also concedes an overthrow. Two leg byes overall by the time the long on fielder can hit the stumps at Bairstow's end.
WIDE. A touch harsh, outside off, just about grazing the wide line, Khan lets it go but the umpire doesn't.
FOUR! Azam is underway! Tremendous bottom hand in that shot. Full, outside off, Azam Khan backs away to the leg side and drives it to the left of mid off, who dives but the ball goes through.
Imad Wasim comes in now. The batsmen crossed, so Azam will be on strike.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fuller ball, around middle and leg, Fakhar Zaman looks to swing for the heavens and he does connect. But does not have the distance. Simple catch for Jason Roy running across to his right from long off. A fine cameo of 26 from 8 balls from the southpaw.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Saqib Mahmood

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, he is finally in. The son of Moin Khan gets one over to showcase his stuff in the final over of the innings. Here is Azam Khan, on international debut. Who will bowl the final over? Saqib Mahmood.

OUT! BOWLED! Lock, stock and barrel. Perfect yorker, around middle and off, Mohammad Hafeez comes forward, looks to flick but plays all over it. Misses and the dipping ball hits the base of the stumps. 16 runs and a wicket from the 19th over.

FOUR! Not a bad ball, but a purely beautiful shot. Full and wide outside off, Hafeez gets his wrists into play, as he turns them gloriously to make the bat face turn and then glide the ball through cover point. Beats sweeper cover to his left. Never easy to play that stroke.
A slower ball, outside off, this one lands on a length, MH looks to cut but gets a bottom edge, which goes on the bounce to the keeper.

SIX! Not quite sure full tosses are the order of the day. Yes, the world is ravishing about that stunning final over from Mitchell Starc to Andre Russell the other night in the Caribbean where he bowled an array of full tosses and yet got 5 dots in a row but certainly, that cannot be the case here. This is outside off and Hafeez swings it over Moeen Ali at mid off.
Good comeback. Perfect yorker, around middle, the Professor can only dig it out back to the bowler.
SIX! BLUDGEONED! Short boundaries and some buffet bowling. Tee off, guys. A full toss, around off, Mohammad Hafeez whips it over deep square leg! Moves to 14 from 5 balls.
Tom Curran is back on. 3-0-31-1 so far.

SIX MORE! 22 from the over! Short and quick, but it is into the crowd. Unlucky for Mahmood. This short ball is around leg stump and Zaman is actually cramped for room as he looks to pull. But the top edge that he gets, sails over long leg! 125/3 in the last 8 overs.

SIX! Mahmood is no spinner but Fakhar has literally swept him away. Slower ball, outside leg, Fakhar Zaman picks it, gets down on a knee and sweeps this massively over fine leg! Moves to 20 from 6 balls and this stand is worth 24 from 9.
Very full, outside off, Mohammad Hafeez steers it behind point for a run.
On a length, around middle, Fakhar moves to the leg side, waits for the ball to come and then steers it towards point for a single.
A touch shorter than full this time, Zaman whips it through mid-wicket, along the ground, for a couple.
SIX! BLAST! Full ball, around the middle and leg, Fakhar Zaman swings it away over deep mid-wicket!
Saqib Mahmood returns. 2-0-15-0 so far.

SIX! BELLIGERNT! A short ball, around middle, Hafeez swings it away over deep backward square leg! 10 runs and a wicket from the over, 103/3 in the last 7 overs. David Willey finishes with figures of 4-0-39-1.
A length ball, slower in pace, Fakhar Zaman gets across and pulls it to fine leg for a single.
A short ball now, Hafeez swivels for the pull but the ball hits the top potion of the bat. Lands in no man's land near square leg. A single taken.
Around off, Mohammad Hafeez pushes it back down the track.
Is is time for Azam Khan? No, the Professor comes along. Here is Mohammad Hafeez.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Babar Azam departs for 85 from 49 balls. End of a stunning exhibition of batting. Willey strikes in his final over. Full, outside off, a touch wide as well, Babar looks to drive but misses. Now, there is a noise as the ball goes past the bat. England appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Jonny Bairstow wastes no time in convincing Eoin Morgan to go for the review. Replays indicate that the bat has not hit the ground and UltraEdge indicates a spike when the ball goes past the bat. End of a terrific innings. Can England keep Pakistan under 210?
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, a full toss, swung to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
David Willey is back on. 3-0-29-0 so far.

FOUR! That's the way to play. Outside off, on a length, Fakhar Zaman steers it very late, past the keeper and beats short third man to his left! 18 from the over, but a wicket as well. 34/2 in the last 2 overs.
A demotion in this game. Normally an opener, Fakhar Zaman has been sent in at number 4. Is this a ploy for the future as well?

OUT! CAUGHT! Mindless batting. One can understand Pakistan wanting to get to 200 and beyond and keep the momentum going, but to just swing listlessly on every ball is a literal insult to the opening partnership. Fractionally short, outside off, Sohaib Maqsood pulls with all his might. But it is flat and straight to David Willey at deep mid-wicket. Not an easy catch though, with the sun coming right in his eyes.
Commentary.Howout: c David Willey b Tom Curran

Commentary.Commentary: A short ball, around middle, SM gets across, looks to pull but misses.
Outside off, Sohaib steers it behind point and gets a couple.

SIX MORE! Is this West Indies batting or Pakistan? 6th six already! Outside off, another slower one, Maqsood gets under this one, walks across and biffs it over mid off who is up. Clears the ropes as well.
SIX! BANG! A length ball, slower in pace, Sohaib Maqsood swings it into orbit and clears mid-wicket with ease! Moves to 11 from 3 balls.
Tom Curran returns. 2-0-13-0 so far.
Around off, Maqsood punches it down to long on for a single. 16 from the over, but a wicket as well. Lewis Gregory's figures read 2-0-25-1.

EDGED, DROPPED, FOUR! Gregory could have had 2 in 2. Outside off, on a length, Sohaib Maqsood looks to drive but his feet are flat footed. The ball wobbles off the seam, moves away and takes the outside edge. It should have been a regulatory catch for Jonny Bairstow but the ball continues to wobble after taking the edge and Bairstow is unable to follow the seam. Gets hit hard on the right hand, and worse, parries the ball behind to the third man fence. Wrings his hand in pain.
Who will walk in now? Some pinch hitter? How about sending Azam Khan? Nope. Trusted experience. Sohaib Maqsood walks in at number 3, replacing Mohammad Rizwan.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stop the press. I repeat, stop the press. England's 'A' team has taken a wicket at last. A slower delivery, into the pitch, back of a length. Rizwan arches back, aiming to play the upper cut over his opposite number, Jonny Bairstow, but the ball follows him and cramps him for room. He almost falls over and the ball takes a thin top edge and dies down on Bairstow but he does well to watch it till the last moment and dive to his left to take the catch. End of a quickfire knock from Rizwan.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Lewis Gregory

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! AUDACIOUS! On a length, outside off, Mohammad Rizwan jumps down the track and smashes it wide of mid off, over his head and to his right, down the ground! 150-RUN STAND IS UP IN 87 BALLS!
Another slower ball, outside off, fuller, the skipper goes hard at it and slices it over cover for a single.

SIX! Up, up and away! Slower ball from Gregory to start his second over and Babar is ready. On a length, outside off, Azam swings this miles into the stands at long on! The stand is worth 145 in 85 balls with Babar making 82 of those!
Right. 6 overs of carnage left. Lewis Gregory has been called back. 1-0-9-0 so far. Did well as per the situation!
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to the off side for one.

FOUR! Matt Parkinson has been taken apart in the last couple of overs! He goes full and wide outside off. But the kind of form Azam is in, he has no problem with anything that comes his way as he sends the ball racing to the extra cover fence.
SIX! All the way! Nicely tossed up, on middle. Azam dances down the track and sends the ball sailing over the mid-wicket fence.
Azam comes down the track and whips it to the right of long on for a couple.
Just eases it to the leg side for one.
FOUR! Powerful stroke! Rizwan gets to the off side so Matt Parkinson throws it wider but Rizwan still sweeps it to the wide long on fence.
Rizwan moves to the off side so Willey fires a yorker on the stumps. Rizwan gets his bat down in time and helps it down to fine leg for one.
Azam goes to the leg side so Willey follows him with a short one. Azam pulls it to fine leg for one.
Full toss, outside off. Rizwan gets it off the inner half of the bat towards long on for one.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Rizwan clips to the right of long on for another couple of runs.
Back of a length, on off. Rizwan pulls it to the leg side. But he doesn't middle it so they get the second. That also brings up his 50! He might look to tee off now.
Slower length ball, down the leg side. Rizwan misses his flick. Wide called.
Yorker, on middle. Rizwan digs it towards long on and even a sprinting Roy cannot stop the second.
David Willey comes back on. He went for 19 in his first two.
Full ball, on off. Azam whips it to the right of long on for a couple.
Rizwan sweeps it yet again towards deep square leg for one.
SIX! Flat six! About Stuart Broad head-high says David Llyod in the commentary box! Fuller ball, outside off. Rizwan gets across and sweeps it very flat all the way over the square leg fence.
Just a single as this is eased to long off.

SIX! In the last over, David Llyod had said that there were still no sixes in the game, so here is the first one! A lovely stroke too! On the pads, Babar Azam gets low and sweeps it all the way over the square leg fence.
On the pads now. Azam comes down the track and clips it towards deep square leg for a couple.

FOUR! And now, Mohammad Rizwan is finding his groove! Loopy ball, on off. Rizwan hits it inside out over covers. The fielder from long off runs to his left and dives but the ball goes past him. Pakistan are in a really good position to put on a big score here!
Loopy ball, on off. Drilled down to long on for one.
50 up for Azam! What a show he has put on so far! Loopy ball, on off. Azam clips it to the right of long on for a couple.
Full ball, on off. Whipped to the leg side for one.
FOUR! Clever batting! Flatter and quicker outside off. Rizwan uses the pace and runs it down to the third man fence.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Azam drills it to long on for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Rizwan looks to slog it away to the leg side but gets no bat on it.
Rizwan goes across the line to the off side so Matt Parkinson bowls it further away from him. Rizwan misses his shot.
Flatter ball, outside off. Tapped to the off side for one.
Excellent by David Willey! Full ball, on middle. Azam whips it away. Willey runs to the left from deep square and dives to stop the ball. His partner throws it back on and they get two.
Tossed up, outside off. Rizwan sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Azam comes down the track and pushes it to long on for one.
FOUR! Thrashed! Flatter ball, outside off. Rizwan gets low and sweeps it to the wide long on fence.
FOUR! That should help him! Rizwan shuffles to the off side as the ball is down the leg side and then sweeps it to the fine leg fence.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rizwan gets the inside edge back on the boot as he looks to slog it. He is struggling to find his timing out there.
Darted on the pads. Azam clips it to the leg side for one.
The leg-spinner now. Shorter and outside off. Azam pulls it to the leg side for a couple.
Starts with an off-spinner, outside off. Pushed to covers.
Spin from both ends! Liam Livingstone comes in the attack.
Short and wide outside off. Cut away past point for one. Just 6 singles from that over then.
Full ball, outside off. Rizwan wants to take on the shorter boundary and sweeps it. But straight towards deep square leg for one.
A nice loopy one, on off. Azam drives it to cover for one.
Shorter ball, on middle. Rizwan hits it down to long on for a single.
Just a single as Azam eases it down to long off.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Rizwan pushes it to the off side for one.
Matt Parkinson comes in the attack. The leg-spinner on this small ground, this should be a great contest!
Rizwan comes down the track and cuts it straight to Morgan at extra cover for one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Rizwan whips it to the left of deep mid-wicket for a couple now.
Short of a length, outside off. Azam pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! He won't miss out on those! Slower length ball, on the pads. Azam pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Hits the deck on a length, on off. Azam gets hit high on the pads as he looks to pull it away.
Back of a length, outside off. Rizwan shuffles across and pulls it to the leg side for one. That also brings the 50 for Pakistan.
Lewis Gregory comes in the attack.
Short of a length, outside off. Azam chops it towards extra cover and yells a big "NOOO". So that is the Powerplay and it has been a good one for Pakistan as they are at 49/0.
Slower ball, full in length and outside off. Rizwan pushes it to point for one.
Swing and a miss! Good length, on off. Rizwan comes down the track to slog it away but gets no bat on it.
Azam taps it to the leg side and scampers through for a quick single.

FOUR! Yet another boundary of the edge! Length ball, on off. It swings away a touch so Azam gets the outside edge while looking to flick. The ball runs between short third man and backward point and runs to the fence.
Back of a length, outside off. Azam cuts it away but Roy dives at point to stop the ball.
Just a single as this is whipped off the pads to deep mid-wicket.

FOUR! Runs are flowing nicely for these two now! Length ball, on off. Azam goes for the slog over mid on but gets the inside edge. The ball goes past the diving short fine leg fielder and runs to the fence.
Bowls a screeching yorker, on middle. Rizwan backs away to the leg side and tries to block it out but gets the inside edge towards the keeper for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Azam flat bats it to mid off. The fumble allows them to scamper through for the run.
Fuller ball, on off. Rizwan gets the inside edge back on the pads. The ball rolls to the off side and they take one.
Length ball, on off. Tapped towards point. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and the ball is deflected but they settle for the single as the man at mid on does well to gather the ball.
Change of ends for Saqib Mahmood.
Tap and run. Good length, around off. Azam taps it to the off side and takes the single. Good batting this by Pakistan. They are targeting the poor balls and respecting the good ones.
Short of a length, on off. Rizwan gets the toe end while looking to pull it. The ball goes to mid on, who attempts a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses. A single is the end result.
FOUR! Nicely done and a brave shot by Rizwan! Slower length ball, on off. Rizwan gets low and sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Mohammad Rizwan has been hit on the helmet so the physio comes out to check it out.
Back of a length, on off. Rizwan gets low and looks to slog it away to the leg side. But gets the top edge and the ball goes to hit his helmet.
Tom Curran comes on.
Length ball, on middle. Azam clips it to the leg side for one.
Length ball, around off. Azam is beaten as he looks to defend.

NOT OUT! Length ball, on leg and Azam gets hit on the pads while looking to flick it. Willey puts in a huge appeal and when he is denied, Morgan decides to review it. But the ball was going down the leg side.
Review time! Morgan has decided to review this for LBW. There is no bat on that one. But the ball is missing the stumps.
FOUR! Make it three-in-three! He timed that to perfection. Full and on the pads. Azam clips it to the left of deep backward square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Azam is getting into the groove now! A nice inswinger on the pads. Azam takes a step down and whips it to the wide long on fence.
The slip comes out now.
FOUR! Good shot by Azam! Just punches it through covers for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Rizwan gets hit on the pads and the ball goes to the off side. Willey chases the ball and throws it at his end but misses. Oooh, a direct hit would have been close!
Much better. Lands in on off and gets it to nip back in. Pushed towards mid on for one.
Full and down the leg side. He gets some in-swing but since he started on the pads, it goes down the leg side. Wide called.
Back of a length, on the pads. Azam clips it towards deep square leg for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away to point.
Rizwan goes for the drive but gets the outside edge down to third man for one.
FOUR! The first convincing boundary of the game! Full ball, outside off. Rizwan punches it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Cut towards point.
Beaten! Lands in on a length, outside off. The ball nips back in and goes between the gate as Rizwan looks to drive.
Who will bowl from the other end? Saqib Mahmood it is.
On the pads. Clipped to the leg side.

FOUR! Off the mark! It came off the edge but it still counts as four runs! Willey bowls a yorker, on off. Azam gets the outside edge and the ball runs between the keeper and the first slip. Willey thought that it hit the pad so he went up for LBW but was denied. Even Morgan thought that it hit the bat and decided not to review.
Weather - It is a beautiful day to play cricket. It is nice and clear and these conditions combined with a crowd make great conditions for cricket in England.
Just short! Fuller ball, outside off. Azam gets the outside edge but it falls just short of Dawid Malan at first slip.
Fuller ball, outside off. Rizwan gets the outside edge down to third man for one.
Beaten! Fuller ball, on off. Rizwan is beaten as he looks to defend.
Starts with a length ball, on off. Rizwan taps it to the off side. Azam wants the single but is sent back by Rizwan, he says that he couldn't hear the call as it is so loud out there!

We are set for the action to begin! The English fielders make their way out to the middle. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam will open the batting for Pakistan. David Willey to start with the ball. Here we go..
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Hafeez, Sohaib Maqsood, Azam Khan, Shadab Khan, Imad Wasim, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow (WK), Liam Livingstone, Moeen Ali, Eoin Morgan (C), Lewis Gregory, Tom Curran, David Willey, Saqib Mahmood, Matt Parkinson.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Eoin Morgan. ENGLAND WILL BOWL FIRST!
Well, even before the game starts, we have some news for you. It is from the Pakistan camp as Azam Khan is set to make his International debut.  He is the son of former Pakistani keeper, Moin Khan.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the first of three T20Is between England and Pakistan. The hosts have been bolstered due to the return of the likes of Eoin Morgan, Jos Buttler, Jason Roy etc. They are the much stronger of the two sides and go in this game with the tag of favorites. Pakistan, on the other hand, are coming off of a disappointing loss in the ODI series. They are still searching for their first win of the tour and would want to get that here. Will they be able to? Or will England continue their dominance? We will find out. With that, a very warm welcome once again. Stay tuned for toss and more updates.
